questions.question: How many males aged 35-44 smoke?
questions.explanation: Males aged 35-44 = 1,000 sample. Smoking rate = 30%. Number = 1,000 × 0.30 = 300.

questions.passage: A hospital reduced its Clostridium difficile infections from 120 cases in 2022 to 84 cases in 2023.
questions.question: What was the percentage reduction in C. difficile infections?

questions.passage: A patient requires gentamicin at 5 mg/kg. The patient weighs 58 kg. Gentamicin is supplied in vials of 80 mg each.
questions.question: How many vials of gentamicin are needed? (Round up to nearest whole vial)
questions.explanation: Total dose = 58 × 5 = 290 mg. Vials needed = 290 ÷ 80 = 3.625. Round up to 4 vials.

questions.passage: A phlebotomy team draws blood from 180 patients per day. Each blood draw takes approximately 8 minutes. The team works 8-hour shifts.
questions.question: How many phlebotomists are needed to complete all draws in one day?
questions.explanation: Total time needed = 180 × 8 = 1,440 minutes = 24 hours. Each phlebotomist works 8 hours. Number needed = 24 ÷ 8 = 3.

questions.passage: A hospital's catering budget is divided between patient meals, staff canteen, and vending services in the ratio 6:3:1. The total annual budget is £500,000.
questions.question: How much is spent on the staff canteen?

questions.passage: A neonate weighing 2.8 kg requires caffeine citrate at 20 mg/kg loading dose. Caffeine citrate solution is 20 mg/mL.
questions.question: How many mL is the loading dose?
questions.explanation: Loading dose = 2.8 kg × 20 mg/kg = 56 mg. Volume = 56 mg ÷ 20 mg/mL = 2.8 mL.

questions.passage: A hospital's emergency department saw 15,000 patients last year. 60% were triaged as Category 3 (urgent). Of these, 85% were seen within the target time of 60 minutes.
questions.question: How many Category 3 patients were seen within the target time?

questions.passage:
The table shows ward occupancy rates:

| Ward | Total Beds | Occupied | Staffed Beds |
|------|-----------|----------|--------------|
| A    | 30        | 28       | 30           |
| B    | 25        | 22       | 25           |
| C    | 35        | 33       | 30           |
| D    | 20        | 19       | 20           |
questions.question: In which ward is the number of occupied beds above the number of staffed beds?
questions.explanation: Ward C has 33 occupied beds but only 30 staffed beds, exceeding staffed capacity by 3.

questions.passage: A laboratory processes blood samples at a rate of 45 samples per hour. The laboratory receives 1,350 samples during a day.
questions.question: How many hours would it take to process all samples if running at full capacity?
questions.explanation: Total samples = 1,350. Rate = 45 samples/hour. Time = 1,350 ÷ 45 = 30 hours.
